fields.name: body
fields.description:
Message body, Here the connector supports AMQP message body types - DATA and VALUE, However, DATA type message bodies  
will be received in Ballerina Byte[] type. VALUE message bodies can be any primitive AMQP type. therefore, the connector  
supports for string, int or byte[]. Please refer Azure docs (https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/java/api/com.azure.core.amqp.models.amqpmessagebody?view=azure-java-stable)  
and AMQP docs (https://qpid.apache.org/amqp/type-reference.html#PrimitiveTypes)

clients.name: Administrator
clients.description:
Ballerina Service Bus connector provides the capability to access Azure Service Bus SDK.
Service Bus API provides data access to highly reliable queues and publish/subscribe topics of Azure Service Bus with deep feature capabilities.

functions.name: init
functions.description:
Initialize the Azure Service Bus Admin client.
Create an [Azure account](https://docs.microsoft.com/en-us/learn/modules/create-an-azure-account/) and
obtain tokens following [this guide](https://docs.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/service-bus-messaging/service-bus-quickstart-portal#get-the-connection-string).
Configure the connection string to have the [required permission](https://docs.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/service-bus-messaging/service-bus-sas).
```ballerina
configurable string connectionString = ?;
asb:Administrator admin = check new (connectionString);
```

parameters.name: connectionString
parameters.description: Azure Service Bus connection string

functions.name: createTopic
functions.description:
Create a topic with the given name or name and options.
```ballerina
asb:TopicProperties? topicProperties = check admin->createTopic("topic-1");
```

clients.name: Caller
clients.description: Represents a ASB caller, which can be used to mark messages as complete, abandon, deadLetter, or defer.

functions.name: complete
functions.description:
Complete message from queue or subscription based on messageLockToken. Declares the message processing to be 
successfully completed, removing the message from the queue.

return.description: An `asb:Error` if failed to complete message or else `()`

functions.name: abandon
functions.description:
Abandon message from queue or subscription based on messageLockToken. Abandon processing of the message for 
the time being, returning the message immediately back to the queue to be picked up by another (or the same) 
receiver.

parameters.name: propertiesToModify
parameters.description: Message properties to modify

return.description: An `asb:Error` if failed to abandon message or else `()`

functions.name: deadLetter
functions.description:
Dead-Letter the message & moves the message to the Dead-Letter Queue based on messageLockToken. Transfer 
the message from the primary queue into a special "dead-letter sub-queue".

parameters.name: deadLetterReason
parameters.description: The deadletter reason

parameters.name: deadLetterErrorDescription
parameters.description: The deadletter error description

parameters.name: propertiesToModify
parameters.description: Message properties to modify

parameters.name: options
parameters.description: Options to specify while putting message in dead-letter queue

return.description: An `asb:Error` if failed to deadletter message or else `()`

functions.name: defer
functions.description:
Defer the message in a Queue or Subscription based on messageLockToken.  It prevents the message from being 
directly received from the queue by setting it aside such that it must be received by sequence number.

parameters.name: propertiesToModify
parameters.description: Message properties to modify

return.description: An `asb:Error` if failed to defer message or else sequence number

clients.name: MessageReceiver
clients.description:
Ballerina Service Bus connector provides the capability to access Azure Service Bus SDK.
Service Bus API provides data access to highly reliable queues and publish/subscribe topics of Azure Service Bus with deep feature capabilities.

functions.name: init
functions.description:
Initializes the connector. During initialization you can pass the [Shared Access Signature (SAS) authentication credentials](https://docs.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/service-bus-messaging/service-bus-sas)
Create an [Azure account](https://docs.microsoft.com/en-us/learn/modules/create-an-azure-account/) and
obtain tokens following [this guide](https://docs.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/service-bus-messaging/service-bus-quickstart-portal#get-the-connection-string).
Configure the connection string to have the [required permission](https://docs.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/service-bus-messaging/service-bus-sas).

parameters.name: config
parameters.description: Azure service bus receiver configuration.(Default receiver mode is PEEK_LOCK)

functions.name: receive
functions.description:
Receive message from queue or subscription.
```ballerina
asb:Message? message = check receiver->receive();
```

parameters.name: serverWaitTime
parameters.description: Specified server wait time in seconds to receive message (optional)

parameters.name: T
parameters.description: Expected type of the message. This can be either a `asb:Message` or a subtype of it.

parameters.name: deadLettered
parameters.description: If set to `true`, messages from dead-letter queue will be received. (optional)

return.description:
A `asb:Message` record if message is received, `()` if no message is in the queue or else an `asb:Error`
if failed to receive message

functions.name: receivePayload
functions.description:
Receive message payload from queue or subscription.
```ballerina
string messagePayload = check receiver->receivePayload();
```

parameters.name: serverWaitTime
parameters.description: Specified server wait time in seconds to receive message (optional)

parameters.name: T
parameters.description: Expected type of the message. This can be any subtype of `anydata` type

parameters.name: deadLettered
parameters.description: If set to `true`, messages from dead-letter queue will be received. (optional)

return.description:
A `asb:Message` record if message is received, `()` if no message is in the queue or else an `asb:Error`
if failed to receive message

functions.name: receiveBatch
functions.description:
Receive batch of messages from queue or subscription.
```ballerina
asb:MessageBatch batch = check receiver->receiveBatch(10);
```

parameters.name: maxMessageCount
parameters.description: Maximum message count to receive in a batch

parameters.name: serverWaitTime
parameters.description: Specified server wait time in seconds to receive message (optional)

parameters.name: deadLettered
parameters.description: If set to `true`, messages from dead-letter queue will be received. (optional)

return.description:
A `asb:MessageBatch` record if batch is received, `()` if no batch is in the queue or else an `asb:Error`
if failed to receive batch

check receiver->abandon(message);

parameters.name: config
parameters.description: ASB listener configurations

methods.name: onMessage
methods.description: Invoked once per message delivered from the queue, topic, or subscription configured on the listener. The entity to consume from and the receive mode (RECEIVE_AND_DELETE or PEEK_LOCK) are configured on the listener's init config, not on the service.

parameters.name: message
parameters.description: The delivered message. Declare a narrower type to project the body, see the messageBody data-binding rule.

parameters.name: caller
parameters.description: Handle for explicitly completing, abandoning, deferring, or dead-lettering the message via its lock token. Needed only when the listener's receiveMode is PEEK_LOCK and autoComplete is disabled; under RECEIVE_AND_DELETE the message is already removed from the entity on retrieval, and with autoComplete enabled the listener settles it automatically.

methods.name: onError
methods.description: Invoked when a message cannot be retrieved from the subscribed entity or cannot be dispatched, most commonly because a delivered message's body fails to bind to the declared parameter type.

parameters.name: error
parameters.description: The failure that prevented the message from being delivered.
